## Your Diwali look, sorted

Diwali is about light, colour and family. Whether you are celebrating in Jaipur, New Jersey, London or Toronto, the right outfit should feel festive and stay comfortable from evening puja to late-night celebrations.

## Diwali outfit ideas

- **Lakshmi puja:** a graceful embroidered cotton suit in plum, violet or peach
- **Diwali card party:** a georgette or taffeta Anarkali with statement jhumkas
- **Office Diwali:** a block print kurta set with a light dupatta
- **Family dinner:** a Nyra cut suit that twirls in every photo

## Trending colours

Royal blue, purple and plum, sage green and soft pastels with gold detailing.

## Shipping, fit and returns

- **Free worldwide shipping** to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia, with tracking
- Ready sizes ship in 2–4 working days; made-to-measure pieces take 5–7 working days, then 5–10 business days for delivery
- **Free custom fit** – send your bust, waist, hip and height and we stitch it for you
- We send you photos of your piece before it ships
- Import duties and taxes included – nothing to pay on delivery

Celebrating abroad? Order early so your outfit arrives on time. [WhatsApp us](https://wa.me/917073350886).

faq.q: When should I order for Diwali delivery abroad?
faq.a: Order 2–3 weeks before Diwali. Ready sizes ship in 2–4 working days, made-to-measure pieces in 5–7 working days, plus 5–10 business days delivery.

faq.q: Are cotton suits festive enough for Diwali?
faq.a: Yes – embroidered and sequin-detailed cotton suits look festive and are far more comfortable than heavy synthetic fabrics.

faq.q: What if I am between sizes?
faq.a: Use the Fit Finder on any product page, or send us your bust, waist, hip and height on WhatsApp and we will stitch the piece to your measurements at no extra cost.

Shipping is free. No. Import duties and taxes are included – we ship duties-paid, so there is nothing extra to pay on delivery. Many small orders are not charged, but it depends on your country's rules.
